choices.reason: The paper names both as main planned contrasts and gives neither priority in the abstract or introduction. None of the six rules separates them: both have participant-level gain means, SDs and counts, and they are distinct contrasts at the same second-stage measurement, with separate controls and neither covering the full sample.

choices.quote: 관심 효과는 time×그룹 2 상호 작용이며, 계획 대비(planned contrasts)로 아래 비교를 핵심 결과로 보고한다. ·도입 효과: (B1의 상승폭) − (B2의 상승폭) ·중단 효과: (A1의 상승폭) − (A2의 상승폭)
